## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
CAUTION. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive; leadership is mixed (Top 5 performers span 3 sectors). Weekly sector breadth is constructive, but Technology is negative over one month and major-stock divergences argue for restraint.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Healthcare leads (+1.44% 1W, +5.89% 1M), with UNH ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.15% | 1M: +11.49%); Real Estate follows (+1.23%, +4.10%), then Energy (+0.93%, +11.03%), with XOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.36% | 1M: +12.99%).

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Communication is weakest (-2.23% 1W, -3.71% 1M); TMUS is BELOW TREND (1W: -7.89% | 1M: -11.38%). Industrials are marginally negative over both periods, with GE BELOW TREND (1W: -8.98% | 1M: -10.54%); Consumer Discretionary is in CORRECTION, with F BELOW TREND (1W: -6.68% | 1M: -7.94%).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
NOW ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.97% | 1M: +15.37%), PANW RECOVERY (1W: +11.27% | 1M: -2.40%), LMT ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.44% | 1M: +15.37%), IBM ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.23% | 1M: +11.67%), and DOW ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.95% | 1M: +14.18%). Leadership: Mixed (3 sectors; neither narrow nor broad).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
F BELOW TREND (1W: -6.68% | 1M: -7.94%), AMAT BELOW TREND (1W: -7.83% | 1M: -20.46%), TMUS BELOW TREND (1W: -7.89% | 1M: -11.38%), NEM BELOW TREND (1W: -8.20% | 1M: -10.25%), and GE BELOW TREND (1W: -8.98% | 1M: -10.54%). Weakness spans consumer, technology, communication, materials and industrials.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W moves include NOW ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.97% | 1M: +15.37%), PANW RECOVERY (1W: +11.27% | 1M: -2.40%), and LMT ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.44% | 1M: +15.37%). Divergences in PANW, MSFT CORRECTION (1W: -0.86% | 1M: +5.34%), and TSLA RECOVERY (1W: +4.93% | 1M: -1.51%) warrant watching for trend breaks.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed: the sector gained 0.69% over 1W but is down 0.95% over 1M; stock-level breadth counts were not supplied. NOW ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.97% | 1M: +15.37%) and ADBE ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.59% | 1M: +10.42%) contrast with NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -1.48% | 1M: -6.06%) and META BELOW TREND (1W: -9.40% | 1M: -17.36%).

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials are modestly positive (+0.02% 1W, +1.37% 1M), but leadership is mixed; stock-level breadth counts were not supplied. V ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.32% | 1M: +10.85%) and MA ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.00% | 1M: +10.33%) contrast with JPM BELOW TREND (1W: -2.40% | 1M: -1.57%).

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare leads on sector returns (+1.44% 1W, +5.89% 1M); stock-level breadth counts were not supplied. UNH ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.15% | 1M: +11.49%) and LLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.31% | 1M: +7.75%) show strength, while JNJ is in RECOVERY (1W: +3.23% | 1M: -2.54%).

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Keep positioning selective under CAUTION: favor demonstrated strength in healthcare and energy, while monitoring mixed technology leadership and reducing exposure to persistent laggards. Style mixed / no clear leadership; avoid treating isolated technology gains as broad confirmation.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: ADBE ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.59% | 1M: +10.42%) and UNH ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.15% | 1M: +11.49%) have supportive news and price confirmation; monitor for follow-through. BEARISH: AMAT BELOW TREND (1W: -7.83% | 1M: -20.46%) and META BELOW TREND (1W: -9.40% | 1M: -17.36%) remain at risk if weakness persists.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Healthcare (+1.44% 1W, +5.89% 1M) and Energy (+0.93%, +11.03%) lead on sector returns. BEARISH: Communication (-2.23%, -3.71%) is weakest; Technology’s positive week (+0.69%) against a negative month (-0.95%) leaves its direction unconfirmed.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Spot-price levels were not supplied, so price support and resistance cannot be specified. Monitor whether NOW ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.97% | 1M: +15.37%) sustains its advance, whether PANW RECOVERY (1W: +11.27% | 1M: -2.40%) turns into an above-trend move, and whether AMAT BELOW TREND (1W: -7.83% | 1M: -20.46%) stabilizes.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
ADBE (+80): record quarter and raised guidance; ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.59% | 1M: +10.42%), sentiment confirmed. UNH (+65): beat-and-raise quarter; ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.15% | 1M: +11.49%), sentiment confirmed. JNJ (+45): ERLEADA treatment update; RECOVERY (1W: +3.23% | 1M: -2.54%), short-term rebound but longer-term divergence.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
AMAT (-40): weak investor-day reaction; BELOW TREND (1W: -7.83% | 1M: -20.46%), sentiment confirmed. ISRG (-55): slower da Vinci growth; ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.00% | 1M: +13.21%), sentiment diverges from price strength—monitor follow-through.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION remains the regime: breadth is 8/11 sectors positive, leadership spans 3 sectors, and style is mixed with no clear Growth or Value lead. NOW ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.97% | 1M: +15.37%) and UNH ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.15% | 1M: +11.49%) show relative strength. Major trend divergence and bearish AMAT news remain risks; AMAT is BELOW TREND (1W: -7.83% | 1M: -20.46%).
